notes.title: R-37 and Aim-120d Added
notes.content:
New missiles added and can be activated in the pre-game settings window

Ai updated to use the new missiles

Various bug fixes

notes.title: Tutorial and Low Level Ai Update
notes.content:
Tutorial improved


Lower difficulty percentage AI now easier 


Default difficulty is now 50% (was 100%)


Many bug fixes

notes.title: Ai Rework and Menu Visual Improvements
notes.content:
The two biggest changes are to the Ai and menus but is also some changes to other areas. 


Ai now can change altitude more freely as well as avoid mountains. In addition it will also be more difficult to fight against.
The menus are now less ugly.
To change radar lock, instead of looking at a target while holding the change lock button and releasing it. You can now hold the lock button which brings up a cursor on the radar screen with which you can simply click and the closest target to the cursor will be locked.
Many other small changes and bug fixes
